rowCountQueries: legacy and governed flag definitions/assignments grouped by org and environment
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Create three empty governed tables and seed two safe-default-off definitions; infer zero org assignments

execution.resumeStrategy: Expand-only DDL uses existence guards and deterministic definition upserts; retry whole migration
execution.idempotency: IF NOT EXISTS and conflict-safe definition inserts converge without duplicating history

quarantine.strategy: No legacy rows are migrated or guessed; legacy/global state remains untouched for explicit later reconciliation

constraints: assignment organization, flag, actor, version, and expiry checks
indexes: org/environment lookup and org/created history indexes
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Verify all constraints, indexes, trigger immutability, RLS policies, grants, and two-org role matrix

recovery.rollback: Disable rollout at application layer; preserve the new empty/additive schema and any audit history
recovery.forwardFix: Ship later additive policy/function corrections; never remove legacy or governed flag rows

queries: row counts, safe-default definitions, constraints, indexes, triggers, RLS, grants, history immutability, and advisors
